notes: The two οὐκέτι are matched in order to the two no more phrases; neither is emptied, both being separately realized, so rule 41's redundant-negative case does not arise.
over him goes to the genitive αὐτοῦ under rule 21, a genitive being a case English realizes with a preposition; hath dominion heads on dominion as the meaning-bearing complement (rules 17, 91).
